headline: Sensex closes up 544 points at 78,639; Nifty also rises 390 points; IT shares see the most buying
summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied, with the Sensex closing up 544 points at 78,639 and the Nifty rising 390 points. IT shares saw the most buying.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities, tracking large listed companies on the BSE and NSE.
why_moved: The input reports broad buying led by IT shares, lifting both benchmark indices during the session.
